title: Chapter 7: Warm Ring-Shadow Rain, Sanctuary Hot Chocolate & The Family Stateroom (Stardate 49602.6)
summary: Caught in their first rainstorm on Caelum-IV, the family discovers that Sanctuary's rain falls at a tropical 82.0°F and turns the Bio-Silica forest into a living marimba orchestra—before scanning native Velvet-Pods to brew Sanctuary Hot Chocolate and curling up together in the Family Stateroom's two King beds.
